assessment_objectives.objective: system components that require diversity are defined.
diversity in system components is created to reduce the extent of malicious code propagation.
endpoints that are generally not considered to be commonly affected by malicious software are identified.
the frequency at which to evaluate evolving threats to endpoints that are generally not considered to be commonly affected by malicious software is defined.

evolving threats to endpoints that are generally not considered to be commonly affected by malicious software are evaluated at the defined frequency to determine whether antimalware protection is required.
